name: -10AN to -12AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler
title: -10AN to -12AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler
description:
The -10AN to -12AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. ColorFittings AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler Fittings are precision-engineered to connect two female AN lines inline, featuring a 360° swivel design for effortless installation and flexible routing in tight spaces, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering plumbing systems.

Each coupler is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. These fittings are designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments commonly found in racing, street performance, marine, and aviation applications.

their AN Female to Female Straight Swivel Coupler Fittings are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with their nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these couplers deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.

For best installation results, the manufacturer strongly recommend using their AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference their installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.
